activity.notes: Representative year 1140 marks Yue Fei's major campaigns against the Jin while serving the Southern Song as a general. ATLAS records this securely documented military milestone rather than using his lifespan as a career rail.

sources.title: Poem to be Sung to the Tune of Full River Red — Yue Fei | Asia for Educators, Columbia University
sources.citation_text: Columbia's Asia for Educators identifies Yue Fei as a Song officer who rose to general and records his successful campaigns against the Jin in 1140.

sources.title: 軍事史적 관점에서 바라본 岳飛의 죽음 — KCI
sources.citation_text: The KCI-indexed military-history study describes Yue Fei's 1140 northward campaign against the Jin in the context of Southern Song military strategy.
